# Healthcare Professionals

This folder catalogs the clinical professionals—primarily physicians, nurses, and allied health specialists—who serve on the steering committee (Styregruppen) for the Danish Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen). These individuals represent various regional hospitals and national professional societies, guiding the clinical quality indicators, governance, and operational frameworks of acute surgical care across Denmark. The folder also includes a conceptual page detailing the specific clinical role and coding challenges associated with the anaestesiologist in acute pre-optimization.

## Pages

- [[anaestesiolog|anæstesiolog]] — Defines the clinical role of the anaestesiologist in acute pre-optimization and highlights coding uncertainties regarding SKS code NAAZ42.
- [[camilla-leidcker|Camilla Leidcker]] — Clinical development nurse from Hvidovre Hospital representing gastroenterological nurses on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[emma-possfelt-moeller|Emma Possfelt-Møller]] — Consultant physician from Rigshospitalet representing the Danish Surgical Society on the database steering committee.
- [[halfdan-lauridsen|Halfdan Lauridsen]] — Lead consultant in acute medicine from Nordsjællands Hospital serving on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[helene-rask-dalby|Helene Rask Dalby]] — Medical doctor from Randers Regional Hospital representing the Danish Society for Clinical Nutrition on the steering committee.
- [[henriette-vind-thaysen|Henriette Vind Thaysen]] — Clinical nurse specialist from Aarhus University Hospital representing clinical nutrition on the steering committee.
- [[jakob-burcharth|Jakob Burcharth]] — Department physician from Herlev and Gentofte Hospital bringing clinical nutrition expertise to the steering committee.
- [[karen-vestergaard-andersen|Karen Vestergaard Andersen]] — Clinical nurse specialist from Aarhus University Hospital representing the Danish Nursing Society on the steering committee.
- [[kasper-gymoese-berthelsen|Kasper Gymoese Berthelsen]] — Lead consultant from Aalborg University Hospital representing anesthesiology and intensive care on the steering committee.
- [[kristian-aagaard-poulsen|Kristian Aagaard Poulsen]] — Consultant physician from Odense University Hospital providing surgical leadership on the steering committee.
- [[line-rokkedal-jonsson|Line Rokkedal Jønsson]] — Development physiotherapist from Amager and Hvidovre Hospital representing physiotherapy on the steering committee.
- [[marianne-vinbaek|Marianne Vinbæk]] — Consultant physician from Aalborg University Hospital representing the Danish Surgical Society on the steering committee.
- [[mette-astrup-tolver|Mette Astrup Tolver]] — Consultant physician from Zealand University Hospital Køge representing the Danish Surgical Society on the steering committee.
- [[mikkel-niklas-frandsen|Mikkel Niklas Frandsen]] — Medical doctor from Zealand University Hospital Køge contributing to regional clinical governance on the steering committee.
- [[nicolai-bang-foss|Nicolai Bang Foss]] — Clinical professor and chief physician from Amager and Hvidovre Hospital representing anesthesiology on the steering committee.
- [[rasmus-haarup-lie|Rasmus Haarup Lie]] — Anaestesiologist and consultant from Aarhus University Hospital representing anesthesiology on the steering committee.
- [[rikke-therkildsen|Rikke Therkildsen]] — Consultant physician from Aarhus University Hospital representing the Danish Surgical Society on the steering committee.
- [[rune-trangbaek|Rune Trangbæk]] — Medical doctor and evidence specialist from Zealand University Hospital providing methodological expertise to the steering committee.
- [[thomas-cotzand|Thomas Cotzand]] — Leading chief physician from Kolding Hospital representing the Danish Surgical Society on the steering committee.
- [[thomas-jorgensen|Thomas Jørgensen]] — Function-responsible consultant physician from Zealand University Hospital supporting operational quality audits on the steering committee.
